about: Allowed exceptions to lint_templates.py (D6 §15.2). One entry per exception: `file` (repository-relative, a glob allowed), `token` (the foreign-literals token), `reason` (required: an entry without one is refused) and, optionally, `match` (a regex the line must contain, so the entry covers one sense of the word or one line, not every line of the file). Every other hit on today's templates is a dataset literal its owner removes (S05, S07, S11, W02, W05, W08...), not an exception.

allow.reason: the v2.2 name kept as an alias of ClassValue for one release (D2 gap 11, BUILD-PLAN B02 and §1 'ClassValue, with TrafficClass = ClassValue kept for one release'); the class itself and the 'IDS' wording are gone. Remove this entry in the release that drops the alias.
the compat section that holds the alias above: the emitter keeps it only for a blueprint that still names TrafficClass (T5r1), so no other package carries the word. Remove it with the alias.
